integrationBasis: Integrated: complete-call managed allocation falls 3.03%/3.06% positional and 3.12%/3.01% keyword. Keyword time falls 5.62%/2.47%, beyond both spreads; positional +0.20%/-0.47% stays within spreads, so no positional speedup. Empty +1.55%/+0.24%, loop +3.91%/-1.43%, full sort -2.35%/-11.67%, pipeline +2.06%/+1.09% remain visible. The first-loop increase is unexplained and does not repeat; no loop benefit is claimed. Sort changes are below 14.20%/20.50% baseline spreads; pipeline increases are below retained spreads. No general sort/pipeline benefit. Empty/loop/pipeline save 8 bytes/job in both allocation passes; sort savings 12679.84/16415.04 bytes remain visible. Accept measured getter/code costs for repeated call allocation saving and keyword improvement; retain every observation without recollection or full lanes.
nativeAssessment: Final emitted Tier1 main Execute changes 3,885 to 3,879 bytes (-6), with inline summaries 33 PGO / 80 single-block / 12 other versus 32 / 80 / 12. ParentContext getter grows 5 to 39 bytes for its checked cast; lexical-class-cell lookup grows 1,078 to 1,112 (5 / 20 / 0 versus 5 / 21 / 0 inlinees). PyFunctionBinding.EnterInvocationFrame falls 1,440 to 1,376 with 9 / 36 / 0 inlinees in both. PyFunctionBase entry and PyExecutableFunction body remain 162 and 196 bytes. The source-unchanged simple-return evaluator changes 4,035 to 4,467 (+432 / 10.71%), with 42 / 182 / 9 versus 53 / 188 / 13 inlinees. Early main OSR remains 8,170; later baseline bodies 4,688/4,592/4,607 differ from candidate 3,886/3,893/3,910. Every emitted body/tier, inline summary and call target is retained. These profile-dependent sizes are not total resident code-cache costs or dynamic call counts, and do not prove CPU causality. The repeated complete-job results support the tradeoff; first-loop variation remains unexplained.
